title: cota tinctoria subsp. fussii
intro: Cota tinctoria subsp. fussii, commonly known as Fuss's dyer's chamomile, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting relaxation. Fuss's dyer's chamomile contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, anti-oxidant, and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and gastrointestinal disorders.
